Improve error messages for invalid `help` arguments
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, any unrecognized argument to `help` (whether a misspelled
command or multiple words) produced the generic "Invalid command format"
message, which gave no actionable guidance.

Two distinct error cases are now handled separately:

- Multiple words (e.g. `help add clear`): format error — shows
  "Invalid command format!" with the usage hint, consistent with how
  other parsers in the codebase handle extra unprefixed input.

- Unknown single word (e.g. `help notexist`): unknown command error —
  shows `Command "notexist" does not exist.` followed by a sorted list
  of all valid command names, so the user knows exactly what to type.

HelpCommand gains VALID_COMMAND_NAMES_SORTED and MESSAGE_UNKNOWN_COMMAND
constants. HelpCommandParser gains a whitespace check before the existing
validity check. Tests are updated and a new parse_multipleWords case
is added.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update UG to reflect help command argument validation
commitResults.messageBody:
The `help` command now validates its argument rather than ignoring
extra input, so the generic "extraneous parameters are ignored" note
no longer applies to it.

- Remove `help` from the list of commands that silently ignore extra
  parameters; update the example to use `list 123` instead.
- In the `help` section, clarify that COMMAND must be a single word,
  and document both error cases: unknown command name (shows valid
  command list) and multiple words (shows invalid format error).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add TestFX dependency for automated UI testing
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds testfx-core and testfx-junit5 4.0.16-alpha to the test
dependencies and a --add-opens JVM arg required for TestFX to
access JavaFX internals under the Java 17 module system.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add automated UI tests for CommandBox, ResultDisplay, PersonListPanel
commitResults.messageBody:
UiTestBase starts a full MainWindow backed by TypicalPersons data
and a temp-dir StorageManager. It exposes submitCommand() and
pressKey() helpers that fire JavaFX events directly on the
application thread, bypassing the OS window focus requirement of
the TestFX robot's write() method (which fails under Gradle).

CommandBoxUiTest covers valid/invalid command submission, error
style class application and removal, and UP/DOWN history navigation.
ResultDisplayUiTest verifies the feedback text for list, unknown
commands, and find results. PersonListPanelUiTest reads the ListView
item count (not rendered cells, which are virtualised) to verify
all 7 typical persons are shown and that find/list correctly filter
and restore the list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Run Gradle under xvfb-run on Linux CI to fix TestFX hang
commitResults.messageBody:
TestFX UI tests require a live display to initialise a JavaFX Stage.
macOS and Windows runners provide one natively; the ubuntu-latest runner
is headless by default, causing the job to stall. Wrap the Gradle
invocation with xvfb-run -a (X Virtual Framebuffer, auto display number)
on Linux only; other platforms are unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep contacts without phone number at bottom
commitResults.messageBody:
Reversing the phone comparator with cmp.reversed() also reversed the
nullsLast ordering, causing null-phone contacts to float to the top in
descending order. Build a separate reversed comparator for this case that
wraps nullsLast around a reversed inner comparator, so null-phone contacts
always appear last regardless of sort direction. Add a test covering the
reversed case.
Keep contacts without phone number at bottom

and undo), and ModelManager.addPerson. These commands no longer reset an

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject extra arguments for list, clear, and exit commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously these commands silently ignored any trailing text, which could
mask user typos and cause confusion (e.g. "clear all" would still wipe
the address book without warning). They now throw a ParseException with
a descriptive message, consistent with the existing undo behaviour.
